scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' INT TERM EXIT; pnpm run dev:api & pnpm run dev:web & wait
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn focusly_api.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.test: pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:video && pnpm run test:web
scripts.test:api: cd apps/api && uv run pytest -q && uv run ruff check focusly_api tests
scripts.test:video: pnpm --dir packages/video test && pnpm --dir packages/video typecheck
scripts.test:web: pnpm --dir apps/web test && pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/web build && pnpm --dir apps/web test:e2e
